from collections import deque

def _components(grid, color):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != color or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                x, y = q.pop()
                cells.append((x, y))
                for p in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color and p not in seen:
                        seen.add(p); q.append(p)
            out.append(cells)
    return out

def _shape(cells):
    r0 = min(r for r,c in cells); c0 = min(c for r,c in cells)
    return tuple(sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells))

def transform(grid):
    # Find the distinctive L-shaped divider and its lower-right compartment.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    for marker in colors:
        for arm in _components(grid, marker):
            if len(arm) < 5:
                continue
            rs = [r for r,c in arm]; cs = [c for r,c in arm]
            r0,r1,c0,c1 = min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            # An L divider whose arms start at the upper-left corner of a region.
            if (r1-r0 >= 3 and c1-c0 >= 2 and
                (r0,c0) in arm and
                all((r,c0) in arm for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and
                all((r0,c) in arm for c in range(c0,c1+1))):
                # A component inside the corner region that has an identical
                # shape elsewhere is the copied object to recolor.
                comps = []
                for color in colors - {marker}:
                    comps.extend((color, comp) for comp in _components(grid,color))
                for color, comp in comps:
                    if all(r > r0 and c > c0 for r,c in comp):
                        shp = _shape(comp)
                        if any(_shape(other) == shp and other != comp
                               for _,other in comps):
                            out = [row[:] for row in grid]
                            for r,c in comp: out[r][c] = marker
                            return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
